description: This file implements a system clock class that provides high-precision, monotonic time measurements. It inherits from BaseClock and allows starting the clock and retrieving elapsed time in nanoseconds, suitable for measuring elapsed durations in real-time applications.

classes.name: SystemClock
classes.description: A monotonic clock implementation for measuring elapsed time, based on system's monotonic clock, not affected by system clock adjustments.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the SystemClock instance, setting initial internal state.

methods.name: int get_time(self)
methods.description: Returns elapsed time in nanoseconds since start(), or 0 if not started.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Starts the clock by recording the current monotonic time.
